subagent_input.last_assistant_message:
Verification complete. The claim is **refuted** as an overreach.

The literal quote exists in the primary source (discussion #2496 — one user wrote "Ghostty + tmux works perfectly with Kitty graphics"), but the claim "confirmed by users to work with tmux and other tools" materially overstates a single cherry-picked forum comment. The broader evidence contradicts "works": it requires the `allow-passthrough on` hack that a Ghostty collaborator calls "still a hack which can and will cause issues," tmux doesn't officially support it, and Ghostty crashes rendering Kitty images in tmux (~100% on images >100kb, 100% with mouse enabled, plus yazi/OpenCode crashes). Confidence: high.
